title: Architecture-First AI Synthesis
subtitle: Structuring Systems Before Generating Code
pullQuote: AI synthesizes the blueprint — it does not invent the architecture.
desc: I do not use AI tools (Cursor Agentic, Copilot) to blindly guess implementation code. Instead, I design relational data schemas, map dependency graphs, and define strict API contracts beforehand. AI serves as a high-speed synthesizer executing a pre-architected blueprint, eliminating hallucinated abstractions and architectural debt.
